answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: penalize the sleeper-then-burst signature. Identities dormant then waking in a synchronized surge are flagged: that is a fleet switched on, not independent agents on their own schedules. A thousand clones held in an ivory lull betray themselves the instant they wake together to swing a vote. A coordinated spike across a canyon of dormant keys is near-impossible for honest users, cheap for one operator. To dodge it the attacker must stagger each fake's life, costing as much as running real independent agents. The quartz tell is breadth waking in unison.
